visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-column reference table grouped by bold full-width label rows
visualCharacteristics.description: No header row. Single-cell bold group-label rows span both columns. Data rows: narrow name column (may contain links) | wide description column. Thin horizontal rules only, no vertical borders or striping.

contentPattern.structure: one row per entry: group row = one cell with the group label (or an empty Description); data row = name cell (text or link) | description cell

usage: Host Response to Infection biomarkers section (Established / Novel / Emerging Inflammatory Markers).
reuseGuidance: Use for grouped term/definition or marker/description lists. Use a plain table block for tabular data with a header row.
